title: Fix date parsing
ask: parse_date in dates.py reads the delivery dates customers type in, and it has the day and month the wrong way round. 03/02/2026 should be 3 February. It should also raise ValueError on rubbish instead of crashing some other way. Tests are in tests/test_dates.py.
background: All our customers are in Australia, so day first is the only format we take.
Two orders went out a month early because of this.
Lachlan checks date code since he wrote the delivery planner.

constraints.text: keep the parse_date function to 12 lines or fewer
put type hints on every argument and the return value of parse_date
give the notes a heading called "What changed"
don't import dateutil, the standard library is enough
leave no print( calls in dates.py
no exclamation marks in the notes
don't message the dev-team channel about it
name Lachlan as the reviewer in the notes
